items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: He didn't know me. He didn't know me. But I knew Segrest's reputation. He knew of my reputation... there's San Frank Segrest, he sees Paul, and there comes Johnny. He picks me up, and Johnny, my boy, and he swings me along, and I'm his loving pal

ctx.x: I know his little brother. I didn't know that was his name.

Burton was his grandfather's name. But she called him at the time, he did seem to like Jews. So he had his name changed to Victor Burton. And incidentally, he got with Alfred Newman, the second drummer, and my brother. And when he found out that my brother was Paul G. D. D. D. D. D. D. D., they were buddy-buddy. I mean his job was secure. You know how he clicked together. The first week I went out to Los Angeles, I must have had dinner in a hundred musicians' houses. They all take me to get acquainted.
